title: GTA V mobile-control adaptation inventory

scope.primary: Current local GTA V resource controls, including common and PC x64 data.
limits: Static declarations are not runtime acceptance.
Axes, directional splits and deprecated aliases are not separate on-screen buttons.
SCRIPT_* inputs are generic channels; mission and minigame meanings require script or gameplay verification.
Latest Online/Editor controls are a separate extension checklist, not proof of this build supporting them.
